## Projects

### StayInKochi — Multi-Hostel Management System

- Developed a multi-hostel management platform serving 1 owner across 4 Kochi locations: Kakkanad, Palarivattom, Thripunithura and Kaloor.
- Built separate Tenant and Owner modules with an owner-approval workflow.
- Implemented food plans, paid hostel switching, Razorpay payments, maintenance requests with photo upload, and group and private chat.
- Technologies: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Razorpay.
- GitHub profile: https://github.com/ajin-varghese-chandy

### Docket — Freelancer and Client Project Management

- Developed a freelancer and client web app with 2 role-based dashboards, project tracking, and a 3-stage invoice workflow: draft, sent and paid.
- Deployed on Vercel.
- Integrated Razorpay payments with server-side signature verification.
- Implemented Google and email sign-in through Firebase Authentication.
- Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase, Razorpay, Tailwind CSS.
- Repository: https://github.com/ajin-varghese-chandy/docket

### Real-Time Internet Speed Monitor — Chrome Extension

- Built a Chrome extension that monitors and displays internet speed in real time.
- Used by 3,000+ users with a 4.2 rating on the Chrome Web Store.
- Technologies: JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Chrome Extension APIs.
